name: Safa Al Harir Tailoring and Embroidery
headline: TAILORING SHOP IN SPRINGS, EMIRATES HILLS, JUMEIRAH, AL BARSHA
lede: Style and Stitch is a noted Corporate tailoring Al Barsha facility. If you are searching for the finest Tailor in Barsha then come to us.
about: Style and Stitch is not only a tailoring service but a cozy place where you feel at ease and where your vision for your dress is sewn into perfection the way you want by our dedicated and professional staff. Our team takes great care in making your dream dress come to life. Our masters and designers are passionate about their work, so every dress is a unique creation.

Our team consists of masters and designers from different nationalities with an experience of 25 years and they specialize in couture dresses, Pakistani, Arabic, Indian and Western dresses as well as abayas and Hand embroidery.
